title_en: The Master of Yunmen: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yunmen Wenyan
author_zh: 雲門文偃 禪師 說 / 門人 守堅 編
author_en: Spoken by Chan Master Yunmen Wenyan (864–949), Compiled by Shoujian
era: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms (Southern Han)
genre: Discourse Record & One-Word Barriers (語錄與一字關)
overview: The razor-sharp, lightning-quick dialogues and sermons of Master Yunmen Wenyan, celebrated for his One-Word Barriers (一字關) and the Three Phrases of Yunmen (雲門三句).

dialogue.speaker: Yunmen / 雲門
dialogue.zh: 師示眾云：「函蓋乾坤，目機銖兩，截斷眾流，隨波逐浪。作麼生商量？」眾無對。
dialogue.pinyin: Shī shì zhòng yún: 'Hán gài qián kūn, mù jī zhū liǎng, jié duàn zhòng liú, suí bō zhú làng. Zuò me shēng shāng liang?' Zhòng wú duì.

red_pine.text: The Master instructed the assembly: 'Enclosing heaven and earth like box and lid; weighing every subtle grain at a single glance; cutting off the flow of all streams; following the waves and pursuing the ripples. How do you deliberate upon this?' The assembly had no answer.

cleary.text: The Master addressed the group: 'Covering heaven and earth, discerning the impulse to the ounce, cutting off all streams, going along with the ripples. How do you assess this?' The crowd had no reply.

sasaki.text: Master Ummon instructed the assembly: 'Enclosing heaven and earth; discerning the pivot to the smallest ounce; cutting off all streams; following the waves. What is your understanding?' The monks were silent.

sections.title_zh: 十五日已前：日日是好日
sections.title_pinyin: Shíwǔ Rì Yǐqián: Rìrì Shì Hǎorì
sections.title_en: Fifteen Days: Every Day is a Good Day

dialogue.speaker: Yunmen / 雲門
dialogue.zh: 師示眾云：「十五日已前不問汝，十五日已後道將一句來。」大眾無對。師自代云：「日日是好日。」
dialogue.pinyin: Shī shì zhòng yún: 'Shíwǔ rì yǐqián bù wèn rǔ, shíwǔ rì yǐhòu dào jiāng yī jù lái.' Dàzhòng wú duì. Shī zì dài yún: 'Rì rì shì hǎo rì.'

red_pine.text: The Master instructed the assembly: 'I do not ask you about before the fifteenth day; after the fifteenth day, say a single sentence!' The assembly had no answer. The Master spoke for them: 'Every day is a good day.'

cleary.text: The Master addressed the assembly, 'I don't ask you about before the fifteenth day; bring me a word about after the fifteenth day.' The assembly had no reply. The Master answered for them, 'Every day is a good day.'

sasaki.text: Ummon said: 'I don't ask you about the days before the full moon; tell me a word about after the full moon.' The monks made no reply. Ummon said: 'Every day is a good day.'

dialogue.speaker: Monk / 僧
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「如何是正法眼藏？」師云：「普。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Rúhé shì zhèng fǎ yǎn zàng?' Shī yún: 'Pǔ.'

red_pine.text: A monk asked: 'What is the treasury of the true Dharma eye?' The Master said: 'Universal!'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'What is the eye treasury of the true teaching?' The Master said, 'Universal.'

sasaki.text: A monk asked: 'What is the Eye Treasury of the True Law?' Ummon said: 'Universal!'

dialogue.speaker: Monk / 僧
dialogue.zh: 問：「如何是雲門一劍？」師云：「祖。」
dialogue.pinyin: Wèn: 'Rúhé shì Yúnmén yī jiàn?' Shī yún: 'Zǔ.'

red_pine.text: Asked: 'What is the single sword of Yunmen?' The Master said: 'Ancestor!'

cleary.text: Asked, 'What is the single sword of Yunmen?' The Master said, 'Ancestor.'

sasaki.text: Asked: 'What is the sword of Ummon?' Ummon said: 'Patriarch!'

dialogue.speaker: Monk / 僧
dialogue.zh: 問：「乾峰一路，趣向如何？」師云：「關。」
dialogue.pinyin: Wèn: 'Qiānfēng yī lù, qùxiàng rúhé?' Shī yún: 'Guān.'

red_pine.text: Asked: 'What is the destination of Qianfeng's single road?' The Master said: 'Barrier!'

cleary.text: Asked, 'What is the orientation of the single path of Qianfeng?' The Master said, 'Barrier.'

sasaki.text: Asked: 'Where does the single road of Kempō lead?' Ummon said: 'Barrier!'

sections.title_en: The Hidden Jewel within the Body

dialogue.speaker: Yunmen / 雲門
dialogue.zh: 師示眾引志公云：「乾坤之內，宇宙之間，中有一寶，秘在形山。拈燈籠向佛殿裏，將三門來燈籠上。」
dialogue.pinyin: Shī shì zhòng yǐn Zhìgōng yún: 'Qiánkūn zhīnèi, yǔzhòu zhījiān, zhōng yǒu yī bǎo, mì zài xíng shān. Niān dēnglóng xiàng fódiàn lǐ, jiāng sānmén lái dēnglóng shàng.'

red_pine.text: The Master cited Master Baozhi to the assembly: 'Inside heaven and earth, within the universe, there is a single jewel, hidden in the mountain of bodily form. Pick up the lantern and bring it into the Buddha hall; take the mountain gate and put it on top of the lantern!'

cleary.text: The Master cited Master Baozhi: 'Within heaven and earth, in the cosmos, there is a treasure hidden in the mountain of form. Bring the lantern into the Buddha hall; put the mountain gate on top of the lantern.'

sasaki.text: Ummon cited Master Hōshi: 'Within the cosmos there is a jewel hidden in the body. Take the lantern into the Buddha hall; set the temple gate on top of the lantern!'
